basic_info.description: This renovated 3BDR/2BA Victorian  complete w a bonus home office/guest space  is everything you've been looking for! With a 93 Walk Score and steps from Cortland's village, this light-filled home offers spacious, open living across two levels - perfect for family, entertaining, and more. The sunwashed living, kitchen, and dining space is the heart of the home, where French doors open to a spacious deck and a pro landscaped stone patio with a lush, private, low-maintenance garden. The reno'd kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless appliances, an induction range, ceramic tile backsplash, and abundant work and storage space. 2 generous BDRs filled w morning light share a full, tiled bath w a vintage clawfoot tub. Upstairs, the sumptuous principal suite offers a walk-out balcony and walk-in closet. Across the hall is an ideal children's BDR and a beautifully renovated tiled bath. The west-facing garden feels like a private resort, shaded by mature palms, evergreens, and a prolific lemon tree. Warm wood floors throughout. The expansive garage offers 2 large storage rooms and potential for future expansion. Just a 1 min walk to Cortland's shops, restaurants, and cafs. A 12-min walk to the Saturday farmers market, and close to tech shuttles, public transit, 101/280 - wow!
